ops.title: Defer Wasmtime loading until the first core operation
ops.description: Pure model/decision metadata imports load the Wasmtime native library before any core operation. Move runtime-only imports into their callers without changing core behavior, WASI, trap/free/reset, model selection or security policy. Paired CI must prove native-library import avoidance and real first-dispatch/warm reuse.

ops.text: Paired baseline proves metadata imports load one native Wasmtime library while the candidate loads none
Independent source/security-invariant review and full CI pass on the exact candidate
Root accepts publication ordering before any release or Capt consumer/install
